text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a gradual v2 cutover for API routes next week. Goal: 24h quiet window, ramp via feature-flagged tenants, telemetry gates. Canops + release team please weigh in.

mira: SG. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across 3 hours each, with telemetry checkpoints at each step.

sam: Quick Q — do we pin any heavy mobile customers to v1 for the first day? I can compile a list.

olivia: Yes please. Mobile SDK teams asked for a 48h grace. Recommend pinning tenants with mobile-traffic > 100k/day for 48h.

harpreet: Ops requirements: autoscale policy for v2 workers enabled, surge capacity +20% for first 6h. Also add a short-term QPS cap per tenant to avoid noisy neighbors.

mira: Telemetry gates (suggested): error rate spike >0.5% absolute OR latency p95 increase >200ms => pause and rollback to previous flag state. Also if embedding mismatch rate >2% for rerank routes.

alex: Sounds good. Can we automate gate checks?

canary-bot: gate-check configured: canary-window=15m, evals=[error_rate, latency_p95, embedding_mismatch], alert_channel=#incidents. Thresholds pending approval.

mira: I'll wire the thresholds into canary-bot. Proposed thresholds: error_rate_delta=0.5, latency_p95_delta_ms=200, embed_mismatch_pct=2.0.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created by alex: v2-flag-cutover-2026-03-25T22:00Z -> preflight checks: schema, auth TTL, header negotiation. Run `/deploybot preflight v2-cutover` before start.

sam: I'll prepare the tenant pin list. Two asks: 1) Make pin toggle accessible to customer success. 2) Add note to release docs about mobile SDK edge case for header-case-sensitivity.

olivia: Agree on both. I'll draft release notes and add migration checklist: SDK bump & casefold header example.

mira: Flag config example (to be applied via rollout service):
```
route: /v2/*
flag: v2_enabled
steps:
  - duration: 3h
    percent: 1
  - duration: 3h
    percent: 5
  - duration: 3h
    percent: 25
  - duration: 3h
    percent: 100
pin_exceptions:
  tenants_by_tag: ["mobile-high-traffic", "enterprise-eu"]
rollback_triggers:
  - error_rate_delta: 0.5
  - latency_p95_delta_ms: 200
  - embed_mismatch_pct: 2.0
```

harpreet: Ops runbook snippets: to pause rollout run: `/rollout pause v2-enabled` to rollback: `/rollout set v2_enabled 0% --force` Ensure team oncall is paged.

alex: Last checks: - confirm release notes + migration guide (olivia) - pinlist (sam) - thresholds wired to canary-bot (mira) - autoscale + qps caps (harpreet) - deploybot preflight run (deploy-bot). If all yes, I'll schedule the rollout.

sam: Pinlist uploaded to shared doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/v2-pinlist (contains tenant IDs and suggested hold windows).

mira: Thresholds wired and smoke eval running on staging. I'll post a quick summary 1h before start.

deploy-bot: Preflight passed on staging at 2026-03-24T18:12Z. Remember to run production dry-run: `/deploybot preflight v2-cutover --env=prod --dry-run`.

olivia: Release notes draft in #docs-review. Added migration code snippet for SDKs and highlighted header normalization caveat.

alex: OK scheduling for 2026-03-25T22:00Z US->EU friendly window. If anyone wants to move earlier/later speak now. Otherwise I'll kick off scheduling and ping oncall. :thumbsup:

harpreet: 👍 ops ready. Will monitor autoscale and QPS caps.

mira: I'll be on watch for telemetry and can trigger pause if thresholds trip.

sam: I'll stand by for pin toggles and customer comms.

alex: Great. Deploybot will post updates in this thread during rollout. Leave any final concerns here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v2-flag-cutover-2026-03-25T22:00Z. Will post canary progress every 15m. Good luck! :rocket:
